This tests that non-scrollable iframes cannot be scrolled with touch.

On success, you will see a series of "PASS" messages, followed by "TEST COMPLETE".


first gesture
PASS touchtarget.contentDocument.body.scrollTop is 0
PASS touchtarget.contentDocument.body.scrollLeft is 0
PASS wheelEventsOccurred is 0
second gesture
PASS touchtarget.contentDocument.body.scrollTop is 0
PASS touchtarget.contentDocument.body.scrollLeft is 0
PASS wheelEventsOccurred is 0
PASS scrollEventsOccurred is 0
PASS successfullyParsed is true

TEST COMPLETE
